contract.grid: flattened target pixels, x-fastest; source owner indexes concatenated left/right source pixels
contract.units: signed 64-bit original observation ID; signed nonnegative 64-bit age in nanoseconds
contract.precision: exact little-endian uint32 low/high pairs, no floating-point conversion
contract.border: t >= width*height has no write; invalid validity/UINT32_MAX/out-of-range owner gives ID -1 and age 0
contract.layout: uint32 owner and validity planes; uint2 source IDs/ages and output IDs/ages
contract.alias: all output planes disjoint from each other and every input; read-only inputs retained through both split passes
contract.ownership: Daxa owns buffers; completion wait precedes host export/reuse; no foreign RHI handles

quality.equality: exact full output ID/age bytes against scalar oracle after resident and transfer-inclusive sample batches; repeated static fixture, no fresh-frame claim
